judged_text: The handler calls appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse (throwing, not safeParse) on req.body for any HTTP method, and JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...)) at lines 57-59 has no error handling, so invalid input escapes as unhandled exceptions. adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler does not gate on `req.method` (no POST-only check), so a GET/other method with missing/invalid body will still execute `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)`, which throws on invalid input. Additionally, `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` is executed without try/catch; invalid ciphertext or decrypt failures will throw and bubble as unhandled exceptions. Both paths can produce 500s instead of controlled 4xx responses, and this is directly visible in the diff.
